newsitem.title: USA: MBIA says $10.2 mln annual Miami exposure.
newsitem.headline: MBIA says $10.2 mln annual Miami exposure.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Monday it has annual debt service exposure to Miami debt of $10.2 million, including $2.1 million in general obligation debt and $8.1 million of revenue bonds.

The bond insurance company said it has net par exposure to Miami GOs of $25 million and net par exposure of $65.7 million to various revenue bond issues. The revenue bonds are not dependent on Miami's general fund, and are paid by dedicated revenue streams from taxes and other sources.
MBIA's insurance pledges that if Miami defaulted the company would make debt service payments to bondholders as they come due.
"MBIA is confident that Miami will not default on any of its obligations," a spokesman for the company said.

The spokesman, Michael Ballinger, noted that Florida's governor has signed an executive order pledging that revenues for principal and interest payments will be placed with a third party trustee to ensure that payments are made.
"We have met with city and state officials and are pleased that all parties are working diligently to ensure that these fiscal problems are resolved," the spokesman said.
